review_focus: Full new proof, restricted marked-triple minimality, and preserved proof dependencies
verified_conclusions: Every cyclic TPP triple in a finite 2-group with minimum factor order at most8 satisfies the size inequality.
An unrestricted minimum counterexample has three equal cyclic orders2^e, e>=4, and ambient order2^(3e-1).
The cyclic inequality holds through ambient order1024, using the retained through256 census and new structural argument.
The source hypertope inequality holds if one distinguished pair-product order is at most16 or ambient group order is at most2^13.
critical_scope_checks: The restricted induction tracks a marked-triple property; quotient images, intersections and powers never increase any factor order.
Every minimality use in the retained power-layer proof remains valid in the restricted class.
Bijective deep-power coordinates come from powerful ordered factorization plus equality, not from TPP plus equality alone.
The top-layer action is on an actual normal elementary-abelian subgroup; no general power-map linearity is assumed.
The unequal-orders conclusion concerns a minimum unrestricted counterexample, not every unequal-order triple.
retained_inputs: Lubotzky-Mann powerful power-subgroup and any-generating-list ordered-coordinate theorems, with source reading inherited from frozen phase11 audit.
Marked-isobicyclic classification used by phase10 smallest-factor-four theorem.
Exact through-order256 finite theorem conditional on GAP4.15.1/SmallGroups1.5.4 catalogue, with archived input hashes checked anew.
Earlier binary square-action lemma and elementary Frattini reductions.
